title: Trump vows 'AI Force' and AI czar, calls safety warnings a 'hoax'
summary: President Trump said he will create an AI czar and a Space-Force-style 'AI Force' to oversee the industry, while dismissing AI safety concerns as a 'hoax'.

title: Bloomberg links Palantir's Maven AI to Iran school strike that killed 123 children
summary: Bloomberg reported that faulty intelligence and over-reliance on Palantir's Maven contributed to a February strike on an Iranian school that killed 123 children; Palantir disputes it.
reason: Investigative evidence of AI-assisted targeting tied to mass casualties; disputed and retrospective.

title: UMG and Sony sue Suno again over v6 music model
summary: Sony Music and Universal Music Group filed a new complaint alleging Suno's v6 model still 'launders' tens of thousands of copyrighted recordings.
reason: Creative-industry legal backlash, development of existing fight.
